exposure: placental pathological findings (poor maternal vascular perfusion, poor fetal vascular perfusion, hematogenous origin infection, ascending infection)
cohort: The study included 109 symptomatic pregnant women with COVID-19.
finding: Moderate SARS-CoV-2 infection presented a higher prevalence of placental pathological findings, particularly hematogenous infection, and there was an unexpected inverse association between prematurity and placental infection of hematogenous origin.
